description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing log viewing in a web UI, including functions for scrolling, fetching log data via AJAX, and updating UI elements related to log display in Apache Spark's web interface.

methods.name: setLogScroll
methods.description: Adjusts the scroll position of the log content to simulate tailing the log.

methods.name: tailLog
methods.description: Scrolls the log content to the bottom to show the latest log entries.

methods.name: setLogData
methods.description: Updates the UI element with current log byte range information.

methods.name: disableMoreButton
methods.description: Disables the 'load more' button when the top of the log is reached.

methods.name: noNewAlert
methods.description: Displays a temporary alert indicating no new log data is available.

methods.name: getRESTEndPoint
methods.description: Constructs the REST API endpoint URL for fetching log data, considering proxy configurations.

methods.name: loadMore
methods.description: Fetches additional older log data and prepends it to the current log view.

methods.name: loadNew
methods.description: Fetches new log data appended since last fetch and appends it to the log view.

methods.name: initLogPage
methods.description: Initializes the log view with parameters and sets up the UI for log display.
